name: web-dev
description: Web development on a modern React stack (React 19, Vite 8, TypeScript 6, Effect 4, TanStack Query 5, React Hook Form 7, shadcn/ui): one entry point, /web-dev:develop, inspects the repository and runs the skills for project setup (a landing page or a web app), feature development, API integration, UI development and deploy setup (CI/CD and Cloudflare Pages); ticket, incident and pr write the contracts around the code, and release takes a merged pull request to production. Its guardrails hook runs before each of Claude's tool calls in every folder while the plugin is enabled and refuses history rewrites, force-pushes, skipped git hooks, pushes to a protected branch, merging a pull request, production deploys and reading secret files.
